$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:dungeon_omen reading for requirement lines. Param is an omen id (a file under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/DungeonOmens/); the reading is 1 when the dungeon run the subject stands in drew that omen, 0 when it did not, and nothing outside a run. A room's ZigRequires gates on it with Min 1, so a door opens or a wave rises only under that omen.
